name: Basilica of St. Stephen
history: Vincentian priests founded St. Stephen in 1849 on land acquired in 1848. Construction of the present church began in November 1871, the first Mass was held on 26 December 1887, the feast of St. Stephen, and it was consecrated on 1 January 1888. It became a basilica in 2022.
arch: Gothic Revival influenced by Minden Cathedral in Germany, in the hall-church plan with naves and aisles of equal height. Its spire, added in 1905-06, is a steel frame wrapped in terra cotta tiles, with stained glass windows of its own.
features: Its extensive stained glass is by Franz Mayer of Munich.
The 1939 pipe organ is among the oldest in the city.

look.d: A steel frame wrapped in terra cotta, added in 1905-06.
Inside, the nave and aisles rise to the same height, flooding it with light.

fun: The first Mass in the church was held on St. Stephen's own feast day, 26 December.
journal: A German-style hall church in New Orleans, Mayer glass glowing. Spire wrapped in tile.

quiz.q: Which German cathedral influenced its design?
What is the spire made of?
a: A steel frame wrapped in terra cotta
